content: Snipe-IT catalog hierarchy: Manufacturer -> Asset Model (model holds default category, manufacturer, custom fieldset, depreciation, EOL) -> individual Asset (unique asset_tag + optional serial, references a model). Custom fields are defined globally then grouped into fieldsets attached to a model, so all assets of a model inherit the same custom field set. Locations are hierarchical (parent/child) and can themselves be treated as a checkout target. Asset tags are always-unique identifiers with barcode/QR label generation (1D barcode for USB scanner lookup, QR for deep link to asset record) rendered via configurable label templates (Admin > Settings > Labels), fully offline/local rendering.
